es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dio este mensaje:

fr.B: La parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} me fut adressée :
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a donné ce message :

sw.B: Neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} likanijia:

decisions.choice: a new message: God speaks to Jeremiah from verse 2 to the end of verse 18
decisions.reason: The opening formula starts a fresh word from God. What follows is spoken to Jeremiah himself, about his own life (verses 2-9), and then about what he is to tell the people (verses 10-18). Verses 19-21 are a prayer of Jeremiah and God's reply, set as poetry.

decisions.choice: The word of the LORD came to me, saying: (L); The word of the LORD came to me: (B); The LORD gave me this message: (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for this formula throughout Jeremiah.

source.text: לֹֽא־תִקַּ֥ח לְךָ֖ אִשָּׁ֑ה וְלֹֽא־יִהְי֤וּ לְךָ֙ בָּנִ֣ים וּבָנ֔וֹת בַּמָּק֖וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Not you shall take for yourself [a] wife, and not shall be to you sons and daughters in the place this.

en.L: "You shall not take a wife for yourself, and you shall not have sons and daughters in this place.
en.B: "Do not marry, and do not have sons or daughters in this place.
en.R: "Do not get married, and do not have any sons or daughters here in this place.

es.L: «No tomarás para ti mujer, ni tendrás hijos ni hijas en este lugar.
es.B: «No te cases, ni tengas hijos ni hijas en este lugar.
es.R: «No te cases, y no tengas hijos ni hijas aquí, en este lugar.

fr.L: « Tu ne prendras pas de femme pour toi, et tu n’auras ni fils ni filles en ce lieu.
fr.B: « Ne te marie pas, et n’aie ni fils ni filles en ce lieu.
fr.R: « Ne te marie pas, et n’aie pas de fils ni de filles ici, en ce lieu.

sw.L: "Usijitwalie mke, wala usiwe na wana na binti mahali hapa.
sw.B: "Usioe, wala usiwe na wana wala binti mahali hapa.
sw.R: "Usioe, wala usiwe na wana au binti yeyote hapa mahali hapa.

vi.L: "Ngươi chớ lấy vợ cho mình, và chớ có con trai con gái tại nơi này.
vi.B: "Đừng lấy vợ, và đừng có con trai con gái tại nơi này.
vi.R: "Đừng lập gia đình, và đừng có con trai hay con gái nào tại nơi này.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah is to stay unmarried and childless: his own life becomes a sign of the coming disaster
decisions.reason: In Israel a man was expected to marry and raise children; to have none was a grief and a loss for the family line. God asks Jeremiah to give this up so that his life shows what is coming: families in this land will not survive (verses 3-4). The prophets sometimes taught by what they did as well as by what they said (13:1-11; Isaiah 8:18; Ezekiel 24:15-24).

decisions.choice: this place: Judah and Jerusalem, the land facing judgment
decisions.reason: "This place" in Jeremiah is often Jerusalem with its temple (7:3, 7; 14:13), and verse 3 widens it to "this land".

decisions.choice: Do not marry / Do not get married
decisions.reason: "Take a wife for yourself" is the Hebrew way of saying "marry". Literal keeps the wording.

source.text: כִּי־כֹ֣ה׀אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה עַל־הַבָּנִים֙ וְעַל־הַבָּנ֔וֹת הַיִּלּוֹדִ֖ים בַּמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וְעַֽל־אִמֹּתָ֞ם הַיֹּלְד֣וֹת אוֹתָ֗ם וְעַל־אֲבוֹתָ֛ם הַמּוֹלִדִ֥ים אוֹתָ֖ם בָּאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּֽאת׃

records.literal_gloss: For thus says Yahweh concerning the sons and concerning the daughters, the [ones] born in the place this, and concerning their mothers, the [ones] bearing them, and concerning their fathers, the [ones] begetting them in the land this:

en.L: For thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} concerning the sons and concerning the daughters who are born in this place, and concerning their mothers who bear them, and concerning their fathers who father them in this land:
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says this about the sons and daughters who are born in this place, about the mothers who give birth to them, and about the fathers who bring them into the world in this land:
en.R: Here is the reason. This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says about the children who are born in this land, and about their mothers and fathers:

es.L: Porque así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} acerca de los hijos y acerca de las hijas que nacen en este lugar, y acerca de sus madres que los dan a luz, y acerca de sus padres que los engendran en esta tierra:
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto acerca de los hijos y las hijas que nacen en este lugar, acerca de las madres que los dan a luz y acerca de los padres que los traen al mundo en esta tierra:
es.R: Esta es la razón. Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} acerca de los niños que nacen en esta tierra, y acerca de sus madres y sus padres:

fr.L: Car ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} au sujet des fils et au sujet des filles qui naissent en ce lieu, et au sujet de leurs mères qui les enfantent, et au sujet de leurs pères qui les engendrent dans ce pays :
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci au sujet des fils et des filles qui naissent en ce lieu, au sujet des mères qui les mettent au monde, et au sujet des pères qui leur donnent la vie dans ce pays :
fr.R: Voici pourquoi. Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} au sujet des enfants qui naissent dans ce pays, et au sujet de leurs mères et de leurs pères :

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi kuhusu wana na kuhusu binti wanaozaliwa mahali hapa, na kuhusu mama zao wanaowazaa, na kuhusu baba zao wanaowazaa katika nchi hii:
sw.B: Kwa maana hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo kuhusu wana na binti wanaozaliwa mahali hapa, kuhusu mama wanaowazaa, na kuhusu baba wanaowaleta duniani katika nchi hii:
sw.R: Hii ndiyo sababu. Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema kuhusu watoto wanaozaliwa katika nchi hii, na kuhusu mama zao na baba zao:

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này về những con trai và con gái sinh ra tại nơi này, về những người mẹ đã sinh ra chúng, và về những người cha đã sinh ra chúng trong xứ này:
vi.B: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy về những con trai con gái được sinh ra tại nơi này, về những người mẹ đã sinh ra chúng, và về những người cha đã sinh ra chúng trong xứ này:
vi.R: Đây là lý do. Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán về những đứa trẻ sinh ra trong xứ này, và về cha mẹ của chúng:

decisions.choice: for: verses 3-4 give the reason for the command in verse 2
decisions.reason: Jeremiah is not to raise children because the children born here, and their parents with them, are going to die.

decisions.choice: the mothers who bear them and the fathers who father them: the whole family, parents and children
decisions.reason: The two verbs name what each parent does in bringing a child into the world. Together with "sons and daughters" they take in every household in the land.

decisions.choice: Thus says the LORD (L); the LORD says this (B); This is what the LORD says (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for this formula throughout Isaiah and Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: Here is the reason; the children ... their mothers and fathers
decisions.reason: Readable puts the link word "for" as a short sentence of its own, says "children" for "sons and daughters", and joins the mothers and fathers in one phrase.

source.text: מְמוֹתֵ֨י תַחֲלֻאִ֜ים יָמֻ֗תוּ לֹ֤א יִסָּֽפְדוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א יִקָּבֵ֔רוּ לְדֹ֛מֶן עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָ֖ה יִֽהְי֑וּ וּבַחֶ֤רֶב וּבָֽרָעָב֙ יִכְל֔וּ וְהָיְתָ֤ה נִבְלָתָם֙ לְמַאֲכָ֔ל לְע֥וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וּלְבֶהֱמַ֥ת הָאָֽרֶץ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: [By] deaths of diseases they will die; not they will be mourned and not they will be buried; as dung on [the] face of the ground they will be; and by sword and by famine they will be finished, and will be their corpse[s] as food for [the] birds of the heavens and for [the] beasts of the earth.

en.L: They will die deaths of diseases; they will not be mourned and they will not be buried; they will be like dung on the face of the ground. And by sword and by famine they will come to an end, and their corpses will be food for the birds of the heavens and for the beasts of the earth.
en.B: They will die of wasting diseases. No one will mourn them or bury them; they will lie like dung on the surface of the ground. Sword and famine will finish them off, and their dead bodies will become food for the birds of the sky and for the wild animals.
en.R: They will die of terrible diseases. No one will weep for them or bury them. Their bodies will lie on the ground like manure. War and famine will kill them, and the birds and the wild animals will eat their dead bodies.

es.L: De muertes de enfermedades morirán; no serán llorados ni enterrados; serán como estiércol sobre la faz de la tierra. Y por la espada y por el hambre serán consumidos, y sus cadáveres serán comida para las aves del cielo y para las bestias de la tierra.
es.B: Morirán de enfermedades que consumen. Nadie los llorará ni los enterrará; quedarán como estiércol sobre la superficie de la tierra. La espada y el hambre acabarán con ellos, y sus cadáveres serán comida para las aves del cielo y para los animales salvajes.
es.R: Morirán de enfermedades terribles. Nadie llorará por ellos ni los enterrará. Sus cuerpos quedarán tirados en el suelo como abono. La guerra y el hambre los matarán, y las aves y los animales salvajes se comerán sus cadáveres.

fr.L: Ils mourront de morts de maladies ; ils ne seront pas pleurés et ne seront pas enterrés ; ils seront comme du fumier sur la face du sol. Et par l’épée et par la famine ils périront, et leurs cadavres seront la nourriture des oiseaux du ciel et des bêtes de la terre.
fr.B: Ils mourront de maladies qui les rongeront. Personne ne les pleurera ni ne les enterrera ; ils resteront comme du fumier à la surface du sol. L’épée et la famine les achèveront, et leurs cadavres serviront de nourriture aux oiseaux du ciel et aux bêtes sauvages.
fr.R: Ils mourront de terribles maladies. Personne ne les pleurera ni ne les enterrera. Leurs corps resteront par terre comme du fumier. La guerre et la famine les tueront, et les oiseaux et les bêtes sauvages mangeront leurs cadavres.

sw.L: Watakufa vifo vya magonjwa; hawataombolezewa wala hawatazikwa; watakuwa kama samadi juu ya uso wa ardhi. Na kwa upanga na kwa njaa watakomeshwa, na mizoga yao itakuwa chakula cha ndege wa angani na cha wanyama wa nchi.
sw.B: Watakufa kwa magonjwa ya kudhoofisha. Hakuna atakayewaombolezea wala kuwazika; watalala kama samadi juu ya ardhi. Upanga na njaa vitawamaliza, na maiti zao zitakuwa chakula cha ndege wa angani na cha wanyama wa porini.
sw.R: Watakufa kwa magonjwa ya kutisha. Hakuna atakayewalilia wala kuwazika. Maiti zao zitalala juu ya ardhi kama mbolea. Vita na njaa vitawaua, na ndege na wanyama wa porini watakula maiti zao.

vi.L: Chúng sẽ chết vì các thứ bệnh tật; chúng sẽ không được khóc thương và không được chôn cất; chúng sẽ như phân trên mặt đất. Chúng sẽ bị tiêu diệt bởi gươm và nạn đói, và xác chúng sẽ làm thức ăn cho chim trời và thú vật trên đất.
vi.B: Chúng sẽ chết vì những bệnh hiểm nghèo. Sẽ không ai khóc thương hay chôn cất chúng; chúng sẽ nằm như phân rác trên mặt đất. Gươm đao và nạn đói sẽ tiêu diệt chúng, và xác chúng sẽ làm mồi cho chim trời và thú hoang.
vi.R: Chúng sẽ chết vì những bệnh tật khủng khiếp. Không ai khóc thương hay chôn cất chúng. Xác chúng sẽ nằm trên đất như phân. Chiến tranh và nạn đói sẽ giết chúng, và chim chóc cùng thú hoang sẽ ăn xác chúng.

decisions.choice: deaths of diseases: death from wasting illness
decisions.reason: The second word comes from a verb meaning "to be sick". The same phrase is used of diseases that bring a slow death (2 Chronicles 21:19). Disease and hunger went with every siege.

decisions.choice: unmourned, unburied, like dung on the ground: the worst disgrace for the dead
decisions.reason: To lie unburied was a curse (Deuteronomy 28:26). Jeremiah uses the same picture of dung on the ground in 8:2 and 9:21, and the birds and beasts eating the dead in 7:33; compare 2 Kings 9:37.

decisions.choice: sword and famine: death in war and from hunger
decisions.reason: These two, often with pestilence, are the disasters of war and siege in Jeremiah (14:12, 15-16).

decisions.choice: manure; war
decisions.reason: Readable says "manure" for dung and "war" for the sword, as the Jeremiah terms list has "war, famine and disease" for the fuller list.

source.text: כִּֽי־כֹ֣ה׀אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אַל־תָּבוֹא֙ בֵּ֣ית מַרְזֵ֔חַ וְאַל־תֵּלֵ֣ךְ לִסְפּ֔וֹד וְאַל־תָּנֹ֖ד לָהֶ֑ם כִּֽי־אָסַ֨פְתִּי אֶת־שְׁלוֹמִ֜י מֵאֵ֨ת הָעָ֤ם־הַזֶּה֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה אֶת־הַחֶ֖סֶד וְאֶת־הָֽרַחֲמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: For thus says Yahweh: Not you shall enter [a] house of mourning-feast, and not you shall go to lament, and not you shall show sympathy to them; for I have taken away my peace from with the people this, declares Yahweh, the loyal love and the compassion.

en.L: For thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: Do not enter a house of mourning feast, and do not go to lament, and do not show sympathy to them; for I have taken away {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} peace from this people, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the loyal love and the compassion.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says this: Do not go into a house where a funeral meal is being held. Do not go there to mourn or to show them sympathy, for I have withdrawn {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} peace from this people, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} loyal love and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} compassion.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: Do not go into a house where people are sharing a meal to mourn the dead. Do not go there to weep, or to comfort the family. I have taken away {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} peace from these people, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. I have taken away {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} faithful love and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} mercy.

es.L: Porque así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: No entres en casa de banquete fúnebre, ni vayas a lamentar, ni te conduelas de ellos; porque he quitado {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} paz de este pueblo, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el amor leal y la compasión.
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: No entres en una casa donde se celebra una comida de duelo. No vayas allí a llorar ni a darles el pésame, porque he retirado {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} paz de este pueblo, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} amor fiel y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} compasión.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: No entres en una casa donde la gente está compartiendo una comida para llorar a un muerto. No vayas allí a llorar ni a consolar a la familia. He quitado {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} paz de esta gente, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. He quitado {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} amor fiel y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} compasión.

fr.L: Car ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : N’entre pas dans une maison de repas de deuil, et ne va pas te lamenter, et ne leur témoigne pas de sympathie ; car j’ai retiré {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} paix à ce peuple, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, l’amour loyal et la compassion.
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : N’entre pas dans une maison où l’on prend un repas de deuil. N’y va pas pour pleurer ni pour leur témoigner ta sympathie, car j’ai retiré à ce peuple {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} paix, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} amour fidèle et {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} compassion.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : N’entre pas dans une maison où des gens partagent un repas pour pleurer un mort. N’y va pas pour pleurer ou pour consoler la famille. J’ai retiré {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} paix à ce peuple, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. J’ai retiré {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} amour fidèle et {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} bonté.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Usiingie katika nyumba ya karamu ya matanga, wala usiende kuomboleza, wala usiwahurumie; kwa maana nimewaondolea watu hawa amani {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, upendo usiokoma na rehema.
sw.B: Kwa maana hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Usiingie katika nyumba ambamo kuna chakula cha matanga. Usiende huko kuomboleza wala kuwafariji, kwa maana nimewaondolea watu hawa amani {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, upendo {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} usiokoma na rehema {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: Usiingie katika nyumba ambamo watu wanakula pamoja kuwaombolezea wafu. Usiende huko kulia, wala kuifariji jamaa. Nimewaondolea watu hawa amani {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Nimewaondolea upendo {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} usiokoma na rehema {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}.

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Ngươi chớ vào nhà có tiệc tang, chớ đi khóc than, và chớ chia buồn với chúng; vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã cất sự bình an của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} khỏi dân này, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, cả tình yêu thương thành tín và lòng thương xót.
vi.B: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Đừng vào nhà đang có bữa ăn tang lễ. Đừng đến đó khóc than hay chia buồn với họ, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã rút lại sự bình an của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} khỏi dân này, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, cả tình yêu thương thành tín và lòng thương xót của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Đừng vào nhà nơi người ta đang cùng ăn bữa tang lễ để tưởng nhớ người chết. Đừng đến đó khóc than hay an ủi gia đình ấy. Ta đã cất sự bình an của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} khỏi dân này, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. Ta đã cất đi tình thương không hề thay đổi và lòng thương xót của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

decisions.choice: a house of mourning feast: a home where a gathering met to share a meal for the dead
decisions.reason: The word (marzeach) names a group that met for a shared meal with drinking. In Amos 6:7 it is a banquet of the rich; here the setting is grief, so it is the meal held with the family of the dead. Verse 7 describes what went on there: bread broken and a cup given to comfort the mourners. The exact nature of the gathering is known only in outline.

decisions.choice: show sympathy: share someone's grief and comfort them
decisions.reason: The verb means to sway or shake the head, a gesture of sorrow made with someone who mourns (15:5; Job 2:11; 42:11).

decisions.choice: God's peace, his loyal love and his compassion are taken away from the people
decisions.reason: Peace (shalom) is well-being in every part of life, given by God. Loyal love (hesed) is his faithfulness to his covenant people, and compassion his tender care for them. All three are the blessings of the covenant; God withdraws them, and so Jeremiah is not to offer comfort either.

decisions.choice: the loyal love and the compassion: further objects of "I have taken away"
decisions.reason: The two nouns stand after "declares the LORD" but belong with "my peace": all three are what God has taken away.

decisions.choice: loyal love (L, B); faithful love (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for hesed in Isaiah and Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: a house where a funeral meal is being held / where people are sharing a meal to mourn the dead; my loyal love and my compassion
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable explain what kind of house is meant, and repeat "my" so the last two nouns clearly go with "taken away". Readable says "mercy" for compassion and repeats the verb.

decisions.choice: karamu ya matanga (Literal); chakula cha matanga (Balanced)
decisions.reason: "Matanga", the days of mourning when friends gather and eat at the bereaved home, is the Swahili custom closest to the Hebrew mourning feast (meaning decision m1).

source.text: וּמֵ֨תוּ גְדֹלִ֧ים וּקְטַנִּ֛ים בָּאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּ֖את לֹ֣א יִקָּבֵ֑רוּ וְלֹֽא־יִסְפְּד֣וּ לָהֶ֔ם וְלֹ֣א יִתְגֹּדַ֔ד וְלֹ֥א יִקָּרֵ֖חַ לָהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And will die great [ones] and small [ones] in the land this; not they will be buried, and not they will lament for them, and not [one] will cut himself and not [one] will make himself bald for them.

en.L: And great and small will die in this land; they will not be buried, and they will not lament for them, and no one will cut [the body] and no one will shave [the head] bald for them.
en.B: Great and small alike will die in this land. They will not be buried, no one will mourn for them, and no one will gash their body or shave their head for them.
en.R: Important people and ordinary people will die in this land. No one will bury them or mourn for them. No one will cut their skin or shave their head to show sorrow for them.

es.L: Y morirán grandes y pequeños en esta tierra; no serán enterrados, ni los lamentarán, ni nadie se hará cortaduras ni se rapará por ellos.
es.B: Grandes y pequeños morirán en esta tierra. No serán enterrados, nadie hará duelo por ellos, y nadie se hará cortes en el cuerpo ni se rapará la cabeza por ellos.
es.R: La gente importante y la gente común morirá en esta tierra. Nadie los enterrará ni hará duelo por ellos. Nadie se cortará la piel ni se rapará la cabeza para mostrar su tristeza por ellos.

fr.L: Et grands et petits mourront dans ce pays ; ils ne seront pas enterrés, et on ne se lamentera pas sur eux, et personne ne se fera d’incisions et personne ne se rasera [la tête] pour eux.
fr.B: Grands et petits mourront dans ce pays. On ne les enterrera pas, personne ne les pleurera, et personne ne se fera d’entailles ni ne se rasera la tête pour eux.
fr.R: Les gens importants et les gens ordinaires mourront dans ce pays. Personne ne les enterrera ni ne les pleurera. Personne ne se fera de coupures sur la peau ou ne se rasera la tête pour montrer sa tristesse.

sw.L: Na wakubwa na wadogo watakufa katika nchi hii; hawatazikwa, wala hawatawaombolezea, wala hakuna atakayejikata [mwili] wala atakayejinyoa [kichwa] upara kwa ajili yao.
sw.B: Wakubwa kwa wadogo watakufa katika nchi hii. Hawatazikwa, hakuna atakayewaombolezea, wala hakuna atakayejichanja mwili au kunyoa kichwa kwa ajili yao.
sw.R: Watu wenye vyeo na watu wa kawaida watakufa katika nchi hii. Hakuna atakayewazika wala kuwaombolezea. Hakuna atakayejichanja ngozi wala kunyoa kichwa kuonyesha huzuni kwa ajili yao.

vi.L: Người lớn kẻ nhỏ đều sẽ chết trong xứ này; chúng sẽ không được chôn cất, người ta sẽ không than khóc chúng, không ai rạch [mình] hay cạo trọc [đầu] vì chúng.
vi.B: Người sang kẻ hèn đều sẽ chết trong xứ này. Chúng sẽ không được chôn cất, không ai than khóc chúng, không ai rạch thân thể hay cạo đầu vì chúng.
vi.R: Người quyền thế lẫn người thường dân đều sẽ chết trong xứ này. Không ai chôn cất hay khóc thương họ. Không ai rạch da hay cạo đầu để tỏ lòng thương tiếc họ.

decisions.choice: great and small: everyone, of every rank
decisions.reason: The pair takes in all the people, from leaders to the poorest (6:13; 8:10).

decisions.choice: cutting oneself and shaving the head: signs of grief for the dead
decisions.reason: Gashing the body and shaving part of the head were mourning customs among Israel's neighbors. The law forbade them to Israel (Leviticus 19:28; Deuteronomy 14:1), but they were still practiced (41:5; 47:5). Here they are named only to say that there will be no mourning of any kind.

decisions.choice: they will not lament ... no one will cut: no one at all will mourn
decisions.reason: The verbs have no named subject; they mean that nobody will do these things.

decisions.choice: [the body], [the head] (L); gash their body, shave their head (B); cut their skin, shave their head to show sorrow (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verbs mean "cut oneself" and "make oneself bald". English needs to say what is cut and shaved. Readable adds why it is done.

source.text: וְלֹֽא־יִפְרְס֥וּ לָהֶ֛ם עַל־אֵ֖בֶל לְנַחֲמ֣וֹ עַל־מֵ֑ת וְלֹֽא־יַשְׁק֤וּ אוֹתָם֙ כּ֣וֹס תַּנְחוּמִ֔ים עַל־אָבִ֖יו וְעַל־אִמּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And not they will break for them over mourning to comfort him over [the] dead, and not they will give to drink them [a] cup of consolations for his father and for his mother.

en.L: And they will not break [bread] for them in mourning, to comfort him for the dead, and they will not give them the cup of consolation to drink for his father or for his mother.
en.B: No one will break bread for the mourners to comfort them for the dead, and no one will give them the cup of consolation to drink for a father or a mother.
en.R: No one will bring food to comfort people who are mourning for the dead. No one will give them a cup of wine to comfort them when their father or mother has died.

es.L: Ni partirán [pan] por ellos en el duelo, para consolarlo por el muerto, ni les darán a beber la copa de consolación por su padre o por su madre.
es.B: Nadie partirá pan para los que están de duelo, para consolarlos por el muerto, ni les darán a beber la copa de consolación por un padre o una madre.
es.R: Nadie traerá comida para consolar a los que lloran a sus muertos. Nadie les dará una copa de vino para consolarlos cuando haya muerto su padre o su madre.

fr.L: Et on ne rompra pas [le pain] pour eux dans le deuil, pour le consoler au sujet du mort, et on ne leur donnera pas à boire la coupe de consolation pour son père ou pour sa mère.
fr.B: Personne ne rompra le pain pour ceux qui sont en deuil, pour les consoler de leur mort, et personne ne leur donnera à boire la coupe de consolation pour un père ou une mère.
fr.R: Personne n’apportera à manger pour consoler ceux qui pleurent un mort. Personne ne leur donnera une coupe de vin pour les consoler quand leur père ou leur mère sera mort.

sw.L: Wala hawatawamegea [mkate] katika maombolezo, ili kumfariji kwa ajili ya aliyekufa, wala hawatawanywesha kikombe cha faraja kwa ajili ya baba yake au kwa ajili ya mama yake.
sw.B: Hakuna atakayewamegea mkate waombolezaji ili kuwafariji kwa ajili ya aliyekufa, wala hakuna atakayewapa kikombe cha faraja wanywe kwa ajili ya baba au mama.
sw.R: Hakuna atakayeleta chakula kuwafariji watu wanaowaombolezea wafu. Hakuna atakayewapa kikombe cha divai kuwafariji wanapofiwa na baba au mama yao.

vi.L: Người ta sẽ không bẻ [bánh] cho chúng trong lúc tang chế để an ủi người ấy vì người chết, cũng không cho chúng uống chén an ủi vì cha hay mẹ mình.
vi.B: Không ai bẻ bánh cho người có tang để an ủi họ vì người chết, và không ai đưa cho họ chén an ủi để uống vì cha hay mẹ đã mất.
vi.R: Không ai mang thức ăn đến an ủi những người đang khóc thương người chết. Không ai đưa cho họ một chén rượu để an ủi khi cha hay mẹ họ qua đời.

decisions.choice: break for them: the Hebrew as written; "bread" is understood
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "break for them". With one small change of vowels the same letters read "break bread", which a few Hebrew manuscripts and the Greek translation have. Either way the sense is breaking bread for the mourners. This description of the manuscripts is from general knowledge.

decisions.choice: bread and the cup of consolation: food and drink brought to mourners by friends
decisions.reason: Neighbors brought a meal to a house in mourning, since the family did not cook (2 Samuel 3:35; Ezekiel 24:17, 22). The cup was a drink given to comfort the grieving, likely wine (Proverbs 31:6).

decisions.choice: him, his father, his mother: each mourner
decisions.reason: The verse moves from "them", all the mourners, to "him", each one who has lost a father or mother.

decisions.choice: the mourners ... them; a father or a mother (B); their father or mother (R)
decisions.reason: English keeps the mourners plural throughout, where the Hebrew turns to each one.

decisions.choice: a cup of wine
decisions.reason: Readable says what the cup likely held.

source.text: וּבֵית־מִשְׁתֶּ֥ה לֹא־תָב֖וֹא לָשֶׁ֣בֶת אוֹתָ֑ם לֶאֱכֹ֖ל וְלִשְׁתּֽוֹת׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And [a] house of feasting not you shall enter to sit with them to eat and to drink.

en.L: And you shall not enter a house of feasting to sit with them, to eat and to drink.
en.B: And do not go into a house where there is feasting, to sit with them and eat and drink.
en.R: Do not go into a house where people are having a feast, to sit and eat and drink with them.

es.L: Ni entrarás en casa de banquete para sentarte con ellos a comer y a beber.
es.B: Tampoco entres en una casa donde haya banquete, para sentarte con ellos a comer y beber.
es.R: No entres en una casa donde la gente está celebrando una fiesta, para sentarte a comer y beber con ellos.

fr.L: Et tu n’entreras pas dans une maison de festin pour t’asseoir avec eux, pour manger et pour boire.
fr.B: N’entre pas non plus dans une maison où l’on fait la fête, pour t’asseoir avec eux, manger et boire.
fr.R: N’entre pas dans une maison où les gens font une fête, pour t’asseoir avec eux, manger et boire.

sw.L: Wala usiingie katika nyumba ya karamu kuketi pamoja nao, kula na kunywa.
sw.B: Wala usiingie katika nyumba ambamo kuna karamu, kuketi pamoja nao kula na kunywa.
sw.R: Usiingie katika nyumba ambamo watu wanafanya karamu, kuketi na kula na kunywa pamoja nao.

vi.L: Ngươi cũng chớ vào nhà có tiệc tùng để ngồi với chúng mà ăn uống.
vi.B: Cũng đừng vào nhà đang có tiệc tùng để ngồi ăn uống với họ.
vi.R: Đừng vào nhà nơi người ta đang ăn tiệc để ngồi ăn uống với họ.

decisions.choice: a house of feasting: a home where a feast with drinking is held, such as a wedding
decisions.reason: The word for feast comes from the verb "to drink". It is used of wedding feasts (Judges 14:10) and other celebrations. Verse 9 names the joy of weddings.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah is cut off from the people's joy as well as their grief
decisions.reason: He may not share their mourning (verses 5-7) or their celebrations. His lonely life shows that both sorrow and joy are coming to an end in the land (15:17).

source.text: כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֜ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הִנְנִ֨י מַשְׁבִּ֜ית מִן־הַמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּ֛ה לְעֵינֵיכֶ֖ם וּבִֽימֵיכֶ֑ם ק֤וֹל שָׂשׂוֹן֙ וְק֣וֹל שִׂמְחָ֔ה ק֥וֹל חָתָ֖ן וְק֥וֹל כַּלָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: For thus says Yahweh of hosts, [the] God of Israel: Here I [am] making cease from the place this before your eyes and in your days [the] sound of joy and [the] sound of gladness, [the] voice of bridegroom and [the] voice of bride.

en.L: For thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, the God of Israel: Look, I am going to make the sound of joy and the sound of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, cease from this place, before your eyes and in your days.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the God of Israel, says this: Before your eyes and in your own lifetime, I am going to silence in this place the sounds of joy and gladness, the voices of bridegroom and bride.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the God of Israel, says: While you are still alive, you will see {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} end the sounds of joy and happiness in this place. No one will hear the happy voices of a bride and groom at their wedding.

es.L: Porque así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, el Dios de Israel: He aquí que haré cesar de este lugar, ante {{plural_you:sus ojos|vuestros ojos}} y en {{plural_you:sus días|vuestros días}}, la voz de gozo y la voz de alegría, la voz del novio y la voz de la novia.
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, el Dios de Israel, dice esto: Ante {{plural_you:sus ojos|vuestros ojos}} y en {{plural_you:su propia vida|vuestra propia vida}}, haré callar en este lugar los sonidos de gozo y de alegría, las voces del novio y de la novia.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, el Dios de Israel: Mientras {{plural_you:ustedes todavía estén|vosotros todavía estéis}} con vida, {{plural_you:verán|veréis}} cómo pongo fin a los sonidos de gozo y felicidad en este lugar. Nadie oirá las voces alegres de los novios en su boda.

fr.L: Car ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël : Voici, je vais faire cesser de ce lieu, sous vos yeux et de vos jours, les cris de joie et les cris d’allégresse, la voix de l’époux et la voix de l’épouse.
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël, dit ceci : Sous vos yeux et de votre vivant, je vais faire taire en ce lieu les cris de joie et d’allégresse, la voix du marié et la voix de la mariée.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël : Pendant que vous êtes encore en vie, vous {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} verrez faire cesser les bruits de joie et de bonheur en ce lieu. On n’entendra plus les voix joyeuses des mariés le jour de leurs noces.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, asema hivi: Tazama, nitakomesha mahali hapa, mbele ya macho yenu na katika siku zenu, sauti ya furaha na sauti ya shangwe, sauti ya bwana arusi na sauti ya bibi arusi.
sw.B: Kwa maana hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, asemavyo: Mbele ya macho yenu na katika maisha yenu wenyewe, nitazinyamazisha mahali hapa sauti za furaha na shangwe, sauti za bwana arusi na bibi arusi.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, analosema: Mkiwa bado hai, mtaniona nikizikomesha sauti za furaha na shangwe mahali hapa. Hakuna atakayesikia sauti za furaha za bibi arusi na bwana arusi katika arusi yao.

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán thế này: Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho tiếng vui mừng và tiếng hân hoan, tiếng chàng rể và tiếng cô dâu, dứt khỏi nơi này, ngay trước mắt các ngươi và trong đời các ngươi.
vi.B: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán như vầy: Ngay trước mắt các ngươi và trong đời các ngươi, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm im bặt nơi này tiếng vui mừng hân hoan, tiếng chàng rể và cô dâu.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán: Khi các ngươi còn sống, các ngươi sẽ thấy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chấm dứt những tiếng vui mừng hớn hở tại nơi này. Sẽ không còn ai nghe tiếng cười nói của cô dâu chú rể trong ngày cưới.

decisions.choice: the sound of joy and gladness, of bridegroom and bride: the same words as 7:34
decisions.reason: The silence of weddings, the most joyful times of town life, means that ordinary life has ended. The words come back in 25:10, and the promise that they will be heard again in 33:11.

decisions.choice: your eyes, your days: the people of Jerusalem, and Jeremiah with them
decisions.reason: "Your" is plural here. God speaks past Jeremiah to the whole generation: the disaster will come in their own lifetime, and they will see it.

decisions.choice: the LORD of hosts: the LORD who commands the armies of heaven
decisions.reason: As in Isaiah 1:9, where the title is explained.

decisions.choice: the wording of 7:34 at each level
decisions.reason: The same Hebrew phrase is rendered the same way each time it returns in Jeremiah. Balanced says "in your own lifetime" for "in your days"; Readable says it as "while you are still alive, you will see".

decisions.choice: the wording of 7:34 at each level
decisions.reason: The same words as 7:34, so each level keeps its wording there.

decisions.choice: the Swahili of 7:34 at each level
decisions.reason: The same words as 7:34 (meaning decision m1); each level keeps its wording there.

decisions.choice: the wording of 7:34 at each level
decisions.reason: The same Hebrew phrase returns from 7:34, so each French level repeats its own wording there.

decisions.choice: the wording of 7:34 at each level
decisions.reason: The same Hebrew words return from 7:34, so each level reuses its wording there.

source.text: וְהָיָ֗ה כִּ֤י תַגִּיד֙ לָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה אֵ֥ת כָּל־הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה וְאָמְר֣וּ אֵלֶ֗יךָ עַל־מֶה֩ דִבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה עָלֵ֨ינוּ֙ אֵ֣ת כָּל־הָרָעָ֤ה הַגְּדוֹלָה֙ הַזֹּ֔את וּמֶ֤ה עֲוֺנֵ֨נוּ֙ וּמֶ֣ה חַטָּאתֵ֔נוּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָ֖אנוּ לַֽיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be, when you tell to the people this all the words these, and they say to you, Concerning what has spoken Yahweh against us all the evil the great this? And what [is] our iniquity, and what [is] our sin that we have sinned against Yahweh our God?

en.L: And it will be, when you tell this people all these words and they say to you, 'Why has {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} spoken against us all this great evil? And what [is] our iniquity, and what [is] our sin that we have sinned against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God?'
en.B: When you report all these words to this people, they will ask you, 'Why has {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} announced this whole great disaster against us? What is our guilt, and what sin have we committed against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God?'
en.R: When you tell these people all this, they will ask you, 'Why has {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said that all these terrible things will happen to us? What wrong have we done? What sin have we committed against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God?'

es.L: Y sucederá que, cuando anuncies a este pueblo todas estas palabras y te digan: “¿Por qué ha pronunciado {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} contra nosotros todo este gran mal? ¿Y cuál [es] nuestra iniquidad, y cuál [es] nuestro pecado que hemos cometido contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios?”,
es.B: Cuando le comuniques a este pueblo todas estas palabras, te preguntarán: “¿Por qué ha anunciado {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} toda esta gran desgracia contra nosotros? ¿Cuál es nuestra culpa, y qué pecado hemos cometido contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios?”.
es.R: Cuando le digas todo esto a esta gente, te preguntarán: “¿Por qué ha dicho {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} que nos van a pasar todas estas cosas terribles? ¿Qué mal hemos hecho? ¿Qué pecado hemos cometido contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios?”.

fr.L: Et il arrivera, quand tu annonceras à ce peuple toutes ces paroles et qu’ils te diront : “Pourquoi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a-t-il prononcé contre nous tout ce grand malheur ? Et quelle [est] notre faute, et quel [est] notre péché que nous avons commis contre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu ?”
fr.B: Quand tu rapporteras toutes ces paroles à ce peuple, ils te demanderont : “Pourquoi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a-t-il annoncé contre nous tout ce grand malheur ? Quelle est notre faute, et quel péché avons-nous commis contre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu ?”
fr.R: Quand tu diras tout cela à ce peuple, ils te demanderont : “Pourquoi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a-t-il dit que toutes ces choses terribles allaient nous arriver ? Qu’avons-nous fait de mal ? Quel péché avons-nous commis contre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu ?”

sw.L: Na itakuwa, utakapowaambia watu hawa maneno haya yote, nao watakuambia, 'Kwa nini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ametamka juu yetu mabaya haya yote makuu? Na uovu wetu [ni] nini, na dhambi yetu tuliyomtenda {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu [ni] nini?'
sw.B: Utakapowaeleza watu hawa maneno haya yote, watakuuliza, 'Kwa nini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ametangaza maafa haya yote makuu juu yetu? Hatia yetu ni nini, na ni dhambi gani tuliyomtenda {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu?'
sw.R: Utakapowaambia watu hawa mambo haya yote, watakuuliza, 'Kwa nini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amesema kwamba mambo haya yote ya kutisha yatatupata? Tumekosa nini? Tumemtenda {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu dhambi gani?'

vi.L: Khi ngươi nói cho dân này mọi lời ấy, chúng sẽ hỏi ngươi: 'Vì sao {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán tất cả tai họa lớn này nghịch cùng chúng tôi? Tội ác của chúng tôi [là] gì, và tội lỗi gì mà chúng tôi đã phạm nghịch cùng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời chúng tôi?'
vi.B: Khi con thuật lại mọi lời ấy cho dân này, chúng sẽ hỏi con: 'Tại sao {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã tuyên bố cả tai họa lớn này nghịch cùng chúng tôi? Chúng tôi có tội gì, và chúng tôi đã phạm tội gì nghịch cùng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời chúng tôi?'
vi.R: Khi con nói với dân này mọi điều ấy, chúng sẽ hỏi con: 'Tại sao {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} lại nói rằng tất cả những điều khủng khiếp này sẽ xảy đến cho chúng tôi? Chúng tôi đã làm gì sai? Chúng tôi đã phạm tội gì nghịch cùng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời chúng tôi?'

decisions.choice: this great evil: this great disaster
decisions.reason: The word can mean moral evil or harm that comes on someone. Here it is the disaster God has announced, as in Isaiah 45:7.

decisions.choice: the questions protest innocence: the people do not see what they have done wrong
decisions.reason: The same pattern of question and answer is found in 5:19 and 13:22, and in Deuteronomy 29:23-25 and 1 Kings 9:8-9. The answer follows in verses 11-13.

decisions.choice: iniquity and sin: the guilt of wrongdoing and the wrong itself
decisions.reason: The two words are used together for the whole of what the people have done against God.

decisions.choice: spoken ... evil (L); announced ... disaster (B); said ... terrible things will happen (R); iniquity / guilt / wrong
decisions.reason: "Spoken evil against" means announcing disaster. For iniquity Balanced has "guilt", as in Isaiah; Readable says "wrong" because "sin" follows at once.

source.text: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם עַל֩ אֲשֶׁר־עָזְב֨וּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֤ם אוֹתִי֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה וַיֵּלְכ֗וּ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וַיַּעַבְד֖וּם וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לָהֶ֑ם וְאֹתִ֣י עָזָ֔בוּ וְאֶת־תּוֹרָתִ֖י לֹ֥א שָׁמָֽרוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Then you will say to them, Because that forsook your fathers me, declares Yahweh, and they walked after gods other and served them and bowed down to them; and me they forsook, and my law not they kept.

en.L: Then you shall say to them, 'Because your fathers forsook {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and went after other gods and served them and bowed down to them; and {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} they forsook, and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} instruction they did not keep.
en.B: Then you are to say to them, 'It is because your ancestors abandoned {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. They followed other gods, served them and bowed down to them. They abandoned {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and did not keep {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} instruction.
en.R: Then tell them, 'It is because your ancestors turned away from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. They followed other gods. They served them and worshiped them. They left {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and did not obey {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} teaching.

es.L: entonces les dirás: “Porque {{plural_you:sus padres|vuestros padres}} {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} abandonaron, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y anduvieron tras otros dioses, y los sirvieron y se postraron ante ellos; y a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} abandonaron, y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} instrucción no guardaron.
es.B: Entonces les dirás: “Es porque {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}} {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} abandonaron, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Siguieron a otros dioses, los sirvieron y se postraron ante ellos. Ellos {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} abandonaron y no guardaron {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} instrucción.
es.R: Entonces diles: “Es porque {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}} se apartaron de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Siguieron a otros dioses. Los sirvieron y los adoraron. Ellos {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} dejaron y no obedecieron {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} enseñanza.

fr.L: Alors tu leur diras : “C’est parce que vos pères {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont abandonné, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et qu’ils sont allés derrière d’autres dieux, et les ont servis et se sont prosternés devant eux ; et {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, ils {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont abandonné, et {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} loi, ils ne l’ont pas observée.
fr.B: Alors tu leur répondras : “C’est parce que vos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}} {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont abandonné, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Ils ont suivi d’autres dieux, ils les ont servis et se sont prosternés devant eux. Ils {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont abandonné et n’ont pas observé {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} instruction.
fr.R: Alors dis-leur : “C’est parce que vos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}} se sont détournés de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Ils ont suivi d’autres dieux. Ils les ont servis et les ont adorés. Ils {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont quitté et n’ont pas obéi à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} enseignement.

sw.L: Ndipo utawaambia, 'Ni kwa sababu baba zenu waliniacha, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wakafuata miungu mingine na kuitumikia na kuisujudia; nao wameniacha {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, wala hawakuishika sheria {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.
sw.B: Ndipo uwaambie, 'Ni kwa sababu babu zenu waliniacha, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Walifuata miungu mingine, wakaitumikia na kuisujudia. Waliniacha wala hawakuyashika mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.
sw.R: Ndipo uwaambie, 'Ni kwa sababu babu zenu waliniacha, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Walifuata miungu mingine. Waliitumikia na kuiabudu. Waliniacha, wala hawakuyatii mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.

vi.L: Bấy giờ ngươi hãy nói với chúng: 'Ấy là vì tổ phụ các ngươi đã lìa bỏ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, và đi theo các thần khác, phục vụ và quỳ lạy chúng; chúng đã lìa bỏ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và không giữ luật pháp {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: Bấy giờ con hãy nói với chúng: 'Ấy là vì tổ tiên các ngươi đã chối bỏ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy. Chúng đã đi theo các thần khác, phục vụ và quỳ lạy các thần ấy. Chúng đã chối bỏ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và không giữ luật pháp {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Bấy giờ hãy bảo chúng: 'Ấy là vì tổ tiên các ngươi đã quay lưng với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. Chúng đã đi theo các thần khác. Chúng đã phục vụ và thờ lạy các thần ấy. Chúng đã lìa bỏ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và không vâng giữ luật pháp {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah's answer is God's own word: "declares the LORD" and "me"
decisions.reason: Jeremiah is to answer in God's name, so the answer speaks as God. It runs from here to the end of verse 13.

decisions.choice: forsook: abandoned the LORD, broke faith with him
decisions.reason: The verb is said twice, at the start and near the end of the verse, framing the list of what the fathers did instead (1:16; 2:13; 5:7).

decisions.choice: my instruction (torah): God's teaching for his people
decisions.reason: The word is wider than a code of laws; it is all that God taught Israel to do (2:8; 6:19; 9:12).

decisions.choice: ancestors; instruction (B) / teaching (R)
decisions.reason: "Your fathers" means the earlier generations, men and women, so Balanced and Readable say "ancestors", as 7:26 does. The wording for torah is the one set for Isaiah and Jeremiah.

source.text: וְאַתֶּ֛ם הֲרֵעֹתֶ֥ם לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת מֵאֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וְהִנְּכֶ֣ם הֹלְכִ֗ים אִ֚ישׁ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ שְׁרִר֣וּת לִבּֽוֹ־הָרָ֔ע לְבִלְתִּ֖י שְׁמֹ֥עַ אֵלָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And you have done evil to act more than your fathers; and here you [are] walking each after [the] stubbornness of his heart, the evil, to not listen to me.

en.L: And you have done more evil than your fathers, and look, you are walking, each one, after the stubbornness of his evil heart, so as not to listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.B: And you yourselves have behaved even worse than your ancestors. Look, each of you follows the stubbornness of your own evil heart and refuses to listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.R: And you have done even worse than your ancestors. Each of you stubbornly follows your own evil heart. You refuse to listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:ustedes han hecho|vosotros habéis hecho}} peor que {{plural_you:sus padres|vuestros padres}}; y he aquí que {{plural_you:andan|andáis}} cada uno tras la terquedad de su malvado corazón, para no escuchar{{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
es.B: Y {{plural_you:ustedes mismos se han portado|vosotros mismos os habéis portado}} aún peor que {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}}. {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, cada uno sigue la terquedad de su propio corazón malvado y se niega a escuchar{{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
es.R: Y {{plural_you:ustedes han hecho|vosotros habéis hecho}} cosas aún peores que {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}}. Cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} sigue con terquedad los malos deseos de su propio corazón. {{plural_you:Se niegan|Os negáis}} a escuchar{{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

fr.L: Et vous, vous avez fait pire que vos pères ; et voici, vous marchez chacun selon l’obstination de son cœur mauvais, pour ne pas {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}écouter.
fr.B: Et vous, vous avez agi encore plus mal que vos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}}. Voyez : chacun de vous suit l’obstination de son cœur mauvais et refuse de {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}écouter.
fr.R: Et vous, vous avez fait encore pire que vos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}}. Chacun de vous suit avec obstination son propre cœur mauvais. Vous refusez de {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}écouter.

sw.L: Nanyi mmetenda mabaya kuliko baba zenu, na tazama, mnakwenda kila mmoja kwa kufuata ukaidi wa moyo wake mbaya, ili msinisikilize.
sw.B: Nanyi wenyewe mmetenda vibaya kuliko hata babu zenu. Tazama, kila mmoja wenu anafuata ukaidi wa moyo wake mwovu na kukataa kunisikiliza.
sw.R: Nanyi mmetenda mabaya kuliko hata babu zenu. Kila mmoja wenu anafuata kwa ukaidi moyo wake mwovu. Mnakataa kunisikiliza.

vi.L: Còn các ngươi đã làm điều ác hơn tổ phụ các ngươi, và kìa, mỗi người các ngươi bước theo sự cứng cỏi của lòng gian ác mình, không chịu nghe {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: Còn chính các ngươi lại cư xử còn tệ hơn tổ tiên mình. Kìa, mỗi người trong các ngươi đều đi theo sự cứng cỏi của lòng gian ác mình và không chịu nghe {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Còn các ngươi đã làm điều còn tệ hơn tổ tiên mình. Mỗi người trong các ngươi đều cứng đầu làm theo lòng gian ác của mình. Các ngươi không chịu nghe {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

decisions.choice: you have done more evil than your fathers: the present generation is worse still
decisions.reason: The answer turns from the fathers to the people asking the question. They cannot plead that the guilt is all their ancestors' (7:26; compare 31:29-30).

decisions.choice: walking after the stubbornness of his evil heart: following one's own will instead of God's
decisions.reason: A phrase Jeremiah uses again and again (3:17; 7:24; 9:13; 11:8; 13:10).

decisions.choice: the stubbornness of his evil heart (L); the stubbornness of your own evil heart (B); stubbornly follows your own evil heart (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for this phrase in Jeremiah, here with "each" and "evil" as the Hebrew has them.

source.text: וְהֵטַלְתִּ֣י אֶתְכֶ֗ם מֵעַל֙ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את עַל־הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א יְדַעְתֶּ֔ם אַתֶּ֖ם וַאֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם־שָׁ֞ם אֶת־אֱלֹהִ֤ים אֲחֵרִים֙ יוֹמָ֣ם וָלַ֔יְלָה אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא־אֶתֵּ֥ן לָכֶ֖ם חֲנִינָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And I will hurl you from on the land this onto the land that not you have known, you and your fathers; and you will serve there other gods day and night, because not I will give to you favor.

en.L: So I will hurl you out of this land into the land that you have not known, you or your fathers, and there you will serve other gods day and night, for I will show you no favor.'
en.B: So I will hurl you out of this land into a land unknown to you and to your ancestors. There you will serve other gods by day and by night, because I will show you no favor.'
en.R: So I will throw you out of this land into a land that you and your ancestors never knew. There you will serve other gods day and night, and I will not be kind to you.'

es.L: Por tanto, {{plural_you:los|os}} arrojaré de esta tierra a la tierra que no {{plural_you:han conocido|habéis conocido}} ni {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} ni {{plural_you:sus padres|vuestros padres}}, y allí {{plural_you:servirán|serviréis}} a otros dioses día y noche, porque no {{plural_you:les|os}} mostraré favor”.
es.B: Por eso {{plural_you:los|os}} arrojaré de esta tierra a una tierra que ni {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} ni {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}} conocieron. Allí {{plural_you:servirán|serviréis}} a otros dioses de día y de noche, porque no {{plural_you:les|os}} mostraré mi favor”.
es.R: Por eso {{plural_you:los|os}} echaré de esta tierra a una tierra que ni {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} ni {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}} conocieron nunca. Allí {{plural_you:servirán|serviréis}} a otros dioses de día y de noche, y yo no seré bondadoso con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}”.

fr.L: Alors je vous jetterai hors de ce pays vers le pays que vous n’avez pas connu, ni vous ni vos pères, et là vous servirez d’autres dieux jour et nuit, car je ne vous ferai pas grâce.”
fr.B: Alors je vous jetterai hors de ce pays vers un pays que ni vous ni vos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}} n’avez connu. Là, vous servirez d’autres dieux jour et nuit, car je ne vous accorderai aucune faveur.”
fr.R: Alors je vous jetterai hors de ce pays, dans un pays que vous et vos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}} n’avez jamais connu. Là, vous servirez d’autres dieux jour et nuit, et je ne serai pas bon pour vous.”

sw.L: Kwa hiyo nitawatupa kutoka nchi hii mpaka nchi ambayo hamkuijua, ninyi wala baba zenu, nanyi mtatumikia huko miungu mingine mchana na usiku, kwa maana sitawapa fadhili.'
sw.B: Kwa hiyo nitawatupa nje ya nchi hii mpaka nchi isiyojulikana kwenu wala kwa babu zenu. Huko mtatumikia miungu mingine mchana na usiku, kwa sababu sitawaonyesha fadhili.'
sw.R: Kwa hiyo nitawatupa nje ya nchi hii mpaka nchi ambayo ninyi na babu zenu hamkuijua kamwe. Huko mtatumikia miungu mingine mchana na usiku, wala sitawatendea wema.'

vi.L: Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ném các ngươi ra khỏi xứ này vào một xứ mà các ngươi và tổ phụ các ngươi không hề biết, và tại đó các ngươi sẽ phục vụ các thần khác ngày đêm, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không ban ơn cho các ngươi.'
vi.B: Vì thế {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ném các ngươi ra khỏi xứ này vào một xứ mà các ngươi và tổ tiên các ngươi chưa từng biết. Tại đó các ngươi sẽ phục vụ các thần khác ngày đêm, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không tỏ ơn cho các ngươi.'
vi.R: Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ném các ngươi ra khỏi xứ này vào một xứ mà các ngươi và tổ tiên các ngươi chưa bao giờ biết. Tại đó các ngươi sẽ phục vụ các thần khác ngày đêm, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không tỏ lòng tốt với các ngươi.'

decisions.choice: hurl: throw out with force
decisions.reason: The verb is used of throwing a spear (1 Samuel 18:11) and of the king hurled into exile in 22:26, 28.

decisions.choice: you will serve other gods there: they will have what they chose
decisions.reason: Those who served other gods at home will serve them in exile, far from God's land (5:19; Deuteronomy 4:28; 28:36, 64).

decisions.choice: I will show you no favor: God himself withholds his kindness
alternatives: for they will show you no favor (the Greek)
decisions.reason: The verb is "I will give". The Greek translation reads "they will give", making the other gods or the foreign people the ones who show no favor. The Hebrew is followed, and agrees with verse 5. This description of the Greek is from general knowledge.

decisions.choice: closing single quote
decisions.reason: Jeremiah's answer to the people, begun in verse 11, ends here. God's speech to Jeremiah goes on.

source.text: לָכֵ֛ן הִנֵּֽה־יָמִ֥ים בָּאִ֖ים נְאֻם־יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹֽא־יֵאָמֵ֥ר עוֹד֙ חַי־יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר הֶעֱלָ֛ה אֶת־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore, look, days [are] coming, declares Yahweh, and not it will be said again, [By the] life of Yahweh who brought up the sons of Israel from [the] land of Egypt,

en.L: Therefore, look, days are coming, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, when it will no longer be said, '[As] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lives, who brought up the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel from the land of Egypt,'
en.B: Therefore, the days are coming, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, when it will no longer be said, 'As surely as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lives, who brought up the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} from the land of Egypt,'
en.R: So a time is coming, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, when people will no longer make a promise by saying, 'As surely as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lives, the God who led the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} out of Egypt.'

es.L: Por tanto, he aquí vienen días, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, en que no se dirá más: “Vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que hizo subir a los hijos de Israel de la tierra de Egipto”,
es.B: Por eso vienen días, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, en que ya no se dirá: “Tan cierto como que vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que hizo subir a los israelitas de la tierra de Egipto”,
es.R: Por eso se acerca el tiempo, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, en que la gente ya no hará promesas diciendo: “Tan cierto como que vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios que sacó a los israelitas de Egipto”.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi voici, des jours viennent, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, où l’on ne dira plus : “[Aussi vrai que] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant, lui qui a fait monter les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël du pays d’Égypte”,
fr.B: C’est pourquoi des jours viennent, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, où l’on ne dira plus : “Aussi vrai que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant, lui qui a fait monter les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} du pays d’Égypte”,
fr.R: Alors un temps vient, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, où les gens ne feront plus de promesse en disant : “Aussi vrai que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant, le Dieu qui a fait sortir les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} d’Égypte.”

sw.L: Kwa hiyo, tazama, siku zinakuja, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ambapo haitasemwa tena, '[Kama] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aishivyo, aliyewapandisha wana wa Israeli kutoka nchi ya Misri,'
sw.B: Kwa hiyo, siku zinakuja, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ambapo haitasemwa tena, 'Kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aishivyo, aliyewapandisha Waisraeli kutoka nchi ya Misri,'
sw.R: Kwa hiyo wakati unakuja, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ambapo watu hawataapa tena kwa kusema, 'Kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aishivyo, Mungu aliyewatoa Waisraeli Misri.'

vi.L: Vì vậy, kìa, những ngày đang đến, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, khi người ta sẽ không còn nói: '[Thật như] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống, Đấng đã đem con cái Y-sơ-ra-ên lên khỏi xứ Ai Cập,'
vi.B: Vì thế, những ngày đang đến, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, khi người ta sẽ không còn nói: 'Thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống, Đấng đã đem con dân Y-sơ-ra-ên lên khỏi xứ Ai Cập,'
vi.R: Vì vậy, thời kỳ đang đến, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, khi người ta sẽ không còn hứa nguyện bằng câu: 'Thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống, là Đức Chúa Trời đã dẫn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên ra khỏi Ai Cập.'

decisions.choice: therefore: the hope that follows grows out of the judgment
decisions.reason: The word usually draws a conclusion. Here it links the coming return to the scattering just announced: because God will drive the people out, a day will come when he brings them back. It can also be read as "but yet", turning from judgment to hope.

decisions.choice: as the LORD lives: the form of an oath
decisions.reason: An Israelite swore by the life of the LORD (4:2; 5:2; 12:16). The words that follow name him by his greatest act: bringing Israel out of Egypt.

decisions.choice: a new exodus that will outshine the first
decisions.reason: The return from exile will be so great that people will name God by it instead of by the exodus from Egypt (Isaiah 43:16-19). Verses 14-15 come back almost word for word in 23:7-8.

decisions.choice: [As] the LORD lives (L); As surely as the LORD lives (B, R)
decisions.reason: The wording used for this oath in 12:16 and in Samuel. Readable adds that saying it is making a promise, as 12:16 does.

decisions.choice: So a time is coming
decisions.reason: Readable says "a time is coming" for "days are coming".

decisions.choice: "los hijos de Israel" (L); "los israelitas" (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: Spanish "hijos" and "israelitas" already include women, so the English gender setting has no Spanish counterpart here or in verse 15.

decisions.choice: wana wa Israeli (Literal); Waisraeli (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch note sets it: "wana" and "Waisraeli" already include daughters, so the English gender span has no Swahili counterpart.

decisions.choice: "lui qui a fait monter" without a deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: French needs the pronoun "lui" to start the relative clause, but it stands inside the oath as part of the name, like the English "who", and is left without the setting.

source.text: כִּ֣י אִם־חַי־יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶעֱלָ֜ה אֶת־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֔וֹן וּמִכֹּל֙ הָֽאֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִדִּיחָ֖ם שָׁ֑מָּה וַהֲשִֽׁבֹתִים֙ עַל־אַדְמָתָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לַאֲבוֹתָֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: but rather, [By the] life of Yahweh who brought up the sons of Israel from [the] land of [the] north and from all the lands where he had driven them there; and I will bring them back to their land that I gave to their fathers.

en.L: but, '[As] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lives, who brought up the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel from the land of the north and from all the lands where {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had driven them.' And I will bring them back to their land that I gave to their fathers.
en.B: but, 'As surely as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lives, who brought up the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} from the land of the north and from all the lands where {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had driven them.' I will bring them back to their own land, which I gave to their ancestors.
en.R: Instead they will say, 'As surely as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lives, the God who led the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} out of the land in the north and out of all the countries where {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had scattered them.' I will bring them back to their own land, the land I gave to their ancestors.

es.L: sino: “Vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que hizo subir a los hijos de Israel de la tierra del norte y de todas las tierras adonde {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los había arrojado”. Y los haré volver a su tierra, la que di a sus padres.
es.B: sino: “Tan cierto como que vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que hizo subir a los israelitas de la tierra del norte y de todas las tierras adonde {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los había arrojado”. Yo los haré volver a su propia tierra, la que di a sus antepasados.
es.R: Más bien dirán: “Tan cierto como que vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios que sacó a los israelitas de la tierra del norte y de todos los países por donde {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los había dispersado”. Yo los haré volver a su propia tierra, la tierra que di a sus antepasados.

fr.L: mais : “[Aussi vrai que] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant, lui qui a fait monter les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël du pays du nord et de tous les pays où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les avait chassés.” Et je les ramènerai sur leur sol, que j’ai donné à leurs pères.
fr.B: mais : “Aussi vrai que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant, lui qui a fait monter les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} du pays du nord et de tous les pays où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les avait chassés.” Je les ramènerai sur leur propre sol, celui que j’ai donné à leurs {{gender:ancêtres|pères}}.
fr.R: Au contraire, ils diront : “Aussi vrai que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant, le Dieu qui a fait sortir les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} du pays du nord et de tous les pays où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les avait dispersés.” Je les ramènerai dans leur propre pays, le pays que j’ai donné à leurs {{gender:ancêtres|pères}}.

sw.L: bali, '[Kama] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aishivyo, aliyewapandisha wana wa Israeli kutoka nchi ya kaskazini na kutoka nchi zote alizokuwa amewafukuzia.' Nami nitawarudisha katika nchi yao niliyowapa baba zao.
sw.B: bali, 'Kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aishivyo, aliyewapandisha Waisraeli kutoka nchi ya kaskazini na kutoka nchi zote alizokuwa amewafukuzia.' Nitawarudisha katika nchi yao wenyewe, niliyowapa babu zao.
sw.R: Badala yake watasema, 'Kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aishivyo, Mungu aliyewatoa Waisraeli katika nchi ya kaskazini na katika nchi zote alikokuwa amewatawanya.' Nitawarudisha katika nchi yao wenyewe, nchi niliyowapa babu zao.

vi.L: nhưng: '[Thật như] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống, Đấng đã đem con cái Y-sơ-ra-ên lên khỏi xứ phương bắc và khỏi mọi xứ mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đuổi họ đến.' {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đem họ trở về xứ của họ mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã ban cho tổ phụ họ.
vi.B: nhưng: 'Thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống, Đấng đã đem con dân Y-sơ-ra-ên lên khỏi xứ phương bắc và khỏi mọi xứ mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đuổi họ đến.' {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đem họ trở về chính xứ của họ, là xứ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã ban cho tổ tiên họ.
vi.R: Thay vào đó, họ sẽ nói: 'Thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống, là Đức Chúa Trời đã dẫn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên ra khỏi xứ phương bắc và ra khỏi mọi xứ mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho họ tản lạc.' {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đem họ trở về chính xứ của họ, là xứ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã ban cho tổ tiên họ.

decisions.choice: the land of the north: Babylon, the land of exile
decisions.reason: Invaders came on Judah from the north (1:14; 4:6; 6:22), since the road from Babylon ran round by the north. The exiles were taken away by the same road.

decisions.choice: he had driven them ... I will bring them back: the oath speaks of God, then God speaks
decisions.reason: Inside the oath God is named in the third person. After it God speaks for himself again and promises the return.

decisions.choice: the land I gave to their fathers: the promise to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob
decisions.reason: God swore to give the land to the patriarchs' descendants (7:7; 11:5; Deuteronomy 1:8). The return renews that gift.

decisions.choice: driven (L, B); scattered (R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to drive away, to banish. Readable says "scattered", a plainer word for the same thing.

decisions.choice: Instead they will say
decisions.reason: Readable repeats the verb from verse 14 because its verse 14 ends a sentence. In both verses Readable says "the God who led" so that the oath clearly names the LORD by what he did.

decisions.choice: "trở về" (return from exile)
decisions.reason: The terms note keeps "trở về" for the homecoming from exile and "quay về", "trở lại" for repentance; this is the first promise of return in the block.

source.text: הִנְנִ֨י שֹׁלֵ֜חַ לְדַיָּגִ֥ים רַבִּ֛ים נְאֻם־יְהוָ֖ה וְדִיג֑וּם וְאַֽחֲרֵי־כֵ֗ן אֶשְׁלַח֙ לְרַבִּ֣ים צַיָּדִ֔ים וְצָד֞וּם מֵעַ֤ל כָּל־הַר֙ וּמֵעַ֣ל כָּל־גִּבְעָ֔ה וּמִנְּקִיקֵ֖י הַסְּלָעִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Here I [am] sending for many fishermen, declares Yahweh, and they will fish them; and after so I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them from on every mountain and from on every hill and from [the] clefts of the rocks.

en.L: Look, I am sending for many fishermen, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and they will fish for them; and after that I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them from every mountain and from every hill and from the clefts of the rocks.
en.B: Look, I am about to summon many fishermen, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and they will catch them. Then afterward I will summon many hunters, and they will hunt them down from every mountain, every hill and the cracks in the rocks.
en.R: Look, I am going to send for many fishermen, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and they will catch these people like fish. After that I will send for many hunters. They will hunt them down on every mountain and hill and in the cracks of the rocks.

es.L: He aquí que yo envío por muchos pescadores, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y los pescarán; y después enviaré por muchos cazadores, y los cazarán por todo monte y por todo collado y por las hendiduras de las peñas.
es.B: Voy a llamar a muchos pescadores, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y los atraparán. Después llamaré a muchos cazadores, y los perseguirán por todo monte, por toda colina y por las grietas de las rocas.
es.R: Voy a mandar llamar a muchos pescadores, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y atraparán a esta gente como a peces. Después mandaré llamar a muchos cazadores. Los perseguirán por todos los montes y colinas y por las grietas de las rocas.

fr.L: Voici, j’envoie chercher de nombreux pêcheurs, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et ils les pêcheront ; et après cela j’enverrai chercher de nombreux chasseurs, et ils les chasseront de toute montagne et de toute colline et des fentes des rochers.
fr.B: Voici que je vais faire venir de nombreux pêcheurs, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et ils les prendront. Ensuite je ferai venir de nombreux chasseurs, et ils les traqueront sur toutes les montagnes, sur toutes les collines et dans les fentes des rochers.
fr.R: Écoutez ! Je vais envoyer chercher beaucoup de pêcheurs, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et ils attraperont ces gens comme des poissons. Après cela, j’enverrai chercher beaucoup de chasseurs. Ils les poursuivront sur toutes les montagnes et les collines, et dans les fentes des rochers.

sw.L: Tazama, ninatuma kuwaita wavuvi wengi, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nao watawavua; na baada ya hayo nitatuma kuwaita wawindaji wengi, nao watawawinda kutoka kila mlima na kutoka kila kilima na kutoka mapango ya miamba.
sw.B: Tazama, karibu nitawaita wavuvi wengi, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nao watawakamata. Kisha baadaye nitawaita wawindaji wengi, nao watawawinda kutoka kila mlima, kila kilima na nyufa za miamba.
sw.R: Tazama, nitawaita wavuvi wengi, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nao watawakamata watu hawa kama samaki. Baada ya hapo nitawaita wawindaji wengi. Watawawinda juu ya kila mlima na kilima na katika nyufa za miamba.

vi.L: Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ sai tìm nhiều người đánh cá, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, và họ sẽ đánh bắt chúng; sau đó {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ sai tìm nhiều thợ săn, và họ sẽ săn chúng trên mọi núi, trên mọi đồi, và trong các kẽ đá.
vi.B: Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sắp gọi nhiều người đánh cá đến, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, và họ sẽ bắt chúng. Sau đó, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ gọi nhiều thợ săn đến, và họ sẽ săn lùng chúng trên mọi núi, mọi đồi và trong các kẽ đá.
vi.R: Này, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sắp sai nhiều người đánh cá đến, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, và họ sẽ bắt dân này như bắt cá. Sau đó {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ sai nhiều thợ săn đến. Họ sẽ săn lùng chúng trên mọi núi, mọi đồi và trong các kẽ đá.

decisions.choice: fishermen: the form the scribes' margin says to read
decisions.reason: The written letters and the margin give two spellings of the same word; both mean "fishermen".

decisions.choice: the fishermen and hunters are enemies sent to catch the people for judgment
alternatives: God's gathering of his scattered people for the return
decisions.reason: Verses 17-18 speak of judgment, and the prophets picture conquerors catching people like fish (Amos 4:2; Habakkuk 1:14-17). Some read the verse with verse 15, as God gathering his people from every place for the return. The judgment reading is followed.

decisions.choice: every mountain, every hill, the clefts of the rocks: no hiding place anywhere
decisions.reason: People fled to the hills and hid in caves and cracks of the rock (Isaiah 2:19, 21; Amos 9:1-3). None of it will hide them.

decisions.choice: catch these people like fish
decisions.reason: Readable says that the fishing is a picture, and that the people are what is caught.

source.text: כִּ֤י עֵינַי֙ עַל־כָּל־דַּרְכֵיהֶ֔ם לֹ֥א נִסְתְּר֖וּ מִלְּפָנָ֑י וְלֹֽא־נִצְפַּ֥ן עֲוֺנָ֖ם מִנֶּ֥גֶד עֵינָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: For my eyes [are] on all their ways; not they are hidden from before me, and not is concealed their iniquity from before my eyes.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} eyes are on all their ways; they are not hidden from before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and their iniquity is not concealed from before {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} eyes.
en.B: For {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} eyes are on every path they take. They are not hidden from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and their guilt is not concealed from {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sight.
en.R: I see everything they do. Nothing they do is hidden from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. Their sin cannot be kept out of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sight.

es.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ojos [están] sobre todos sus caminos; no se esconden de delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, ni su iniquidad está oculta de delante de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ojos.
es.B: Porque {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ojos están sobre todos los caminos que siguen. No se esconden de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, y su culpa no está oculta a {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ojos.
es.R: Yo veo todo lo que hacen. Nada de lo que hacen se {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} oculta. Su pecado no puede esconderse de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} vista.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} yeux [sont] sur toutes leurs voies ; elles ne sont pas cachées devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, et leur faute n’est pas dissimulée à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} yeux.
fr.B: Car {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} yeux suivent tous leurs chemins. Ils ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} sont pas cachés, et leur faute n’échappe pas à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} regard.
fr.R: Je vois tout ce qu’ils font. Rien de ce qu’ils font ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}est caché. Leur péché ne peut pas échapper à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} regard.

sw.L: Kwa maana macho {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} [yako] juu ya njia zao zote; hazijafichika mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, wala uovu wao haukusitirika mbele ya macho {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.
sw.B: Kwa maana macho {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} yanaona kila njia wanayoipita. Hawajafichika {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}, wala hatia yao haijasitirika machoni {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}}.
sw.R: Ninaona kila kitu wanachokifanya. Hakuna wanachokifanya kilichofichika {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}. Dhambi yao haiwezi kufichwa machoni {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}}.

vi.L: Vì mắt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nhìn mọi đường lối chúng; chúng không bị che khuất khỏi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và tội ác chúng không bị giấu khỏi trước mắt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: Vì mắt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} dõi theo mọi con đường chúng đi. Chúng không bị che khuất khỏi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và tội lỗi chúng không thể giấu khỏi mắt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Ta thấy mọi việc chúng làm. Không việc gì chúng làm bị giấu khỏi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Tội lỗi của chúng không thể che khuất khỏi mắt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

decisions.choice: my eyes are on all their ways: I see all that they do
decisions.reason: "Ways" are a person's conduct, the paths they take in life (32:19). God's eyes on them here means that he sees, so that none can escape (verse 16).

decisions.choice: iniquity: the guilt of their wrongdoing
decisions.reason: As in verse 10.

decisions.choice: iniquity (L); guilt (B); sin (R); sight (B, R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for this word in Isaiah. Readable says "I see everything they do" for "my eyes are on all their ways".

source.text: וְשִׁלַּמְתִּ֣י רִֽאשׁוֹנָ֗ה מִשְׁנֵ֤ה עֲוֺנָם֙ וְחַטָּאתָ֔ם עַ֖ל חַלְּלָ֣ם אֶת־אַרְצִ֑י בְּנִבְלַ֤ת שִׁקּֽוּצֵיהֶם֙ וְתוֹעֲב֣וֹתֵיהֶ֔ם מָלְא֖וּ אֶת־נַחֲלָתִֽי׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And I will repay first [the] double of their iniquity and their sin, because they profaned my land with [the] corpse[s] of their detestable things, and [with] their abominations they have filled my inheritance.

en.L: And I will repay first the double of their iniquity and their sin, because they have defiled {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} land with the corpses of their detestable things, and with their abominations they have filled {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} inheritance."
en.B: First I will repay them double for their guilt and their sin, because they have defiled {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} land with the lifeless corpses of their detestable idols and filled {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} inheritance with their abominations."
en.R: But first I will pay them back twice over for their sin and guilt. They have made {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} land unclean with their dead, worthless idols. They have filled the land that belongs to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} with things I hate."

es.L: Y pagaré primero el doble de su iniquidad y de su pecado, porque profanaron {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} tierra con los cadáveres de sus ídolos detestables, y con sus abominaciones llenaron {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} heredad».
es.B: Primero les pagaré el doble por su culpa y su pecado, porque han profanado {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} tierra con los cadáveres sin vida de sus ídolos detestables y han llenado {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} heredad con sus abominaciones».
es.R: Pero primero les daré el doble de lo que merecen por su pecado y su culpa. Han hecho impura {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} tierra con sus ídolos muertos y sin valor. Han llenado la tierra que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pertenece de cosas que yo detesto».

fr.L: Et je leur rendrai d’abord le double de leur faute et de leur péché, parce qu’ils ont profané {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} pays avec les cadavres de leurs idoles détestables, et de leurs abominations ils ont rempli {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} héritage. »
fr.B: D’abord, je leur ferai payer au double leur faute et leur péché, parce qu’ils ont profané {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} pays avec les cadavres sans vie de leurs idoles détestables, et qu’ils ont rempli {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} héritage de leurs abominations. »
fr.R: Mais d’abord, je leur ferai payer deux fois leur péché et leur faute. Ils ont rendu {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} pays impur avec leurs idoles mortes et sans valeur. Ils ont rempli le pays qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appartient de choses que je déteste. »

sw.L: Nami nitalipa kwanza mara mbili ya uovu wao na dhambi yao, kwa sababu wameinajisi nchi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} kwa mizoga ya machukizo yao, na kwa machukizo yao wameujaza urithi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}."
sw.B: Kwanza nitawalipa mara mbili kwa hatia yao na dhambi yao, kwa sababu wameinajisi nchi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} kwa mizoga isiyo na uhai ya sanamu zao za kuchukiza, na kuujaza urithi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} machukizo yao."
sw.R: Lakini kwanza nitawalipa mara mbili kwa dhambi zao na hatia yao. Wameifanya nchi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} kuwa najisi kwa sanamu zao zisizo na uhai wala faida. Wameijaza nchi iliyo mali {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} mambo ninayoyachukia."

vi.L: Trước hết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ báo trả gấp đôi tội ác và tội lỗi của chúng, vì chúng đã làm ô uế đất {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bằng xác chết của các vật ghê tởm của chúng, và chúng đã làm cho cơ nghiệp {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đầy dẫy những điều gớm ghiếc của chúng."
